section.p: Senior software engineer specializing in data integration, XML based publishing chains, structured corpora and schema driven CMS systems. Over 25 years designing pipelines that extract, transform and load complex structured or semi structured data into search engines, XML or NoSQL databases and downstream applications. Practical ETL experience (Talend, custom pipelines, in house ESB), strong background in SGML/XML publishing chains, and working knowledge of semantic technologies (RDF, SKOS, DCAT & DCAT AP). Motivated to apply this background to open data and knowledge graph projects.

li.p: Design and implementation of XML centric processing chains: parsing, validation, enrichment, XSLT based transformations, loading into XML or NoSQL stores and search indexes.
ETL style workflows using Talend Open Studio and custom integration scripts for extraction, transformation, quality checks and loading into databases.
Architecture of an internal ESB style orchestration layer connecting ERP, CMS, payment systems and external partners through XML/JSON APIs and file based exchanges.
Use of Ballerina language for microservice proofs of concept, API gateways, orchestration flows and data transformation services.
Working knowledge of RDF, RDFS, OWL, SKOS; understanding of modeling vocabularies and entity relationships.
Familiarity with DCAT and DCAT AP for dataset cataloging in open data platforms.
Conceptual knowledge of CKAN, EntryScape and Virtuoso; fast learner thanks to long experience with structured data and APIs.
Design of indexing strategies and search schemas for large textual and bibliographic corpora.
Practical experience with Lucene (basis of Solr) and Vespa for full text search, filtering and faceting.
Building structured corpora from SGML, XML or relational sources and exposing them via search and API layers.
Schema driven design of document types (articles, dictionaries, resumes, technical documentation) using XML/XSD.

Design and maintenance of a schema driven CMS demonstrator with multi version XML documents, applicability based filtering, XSD driven WYSIWYG editing (Xopus) and multi channel publishing (HTML, markdown, PDF). Demo:
http://www.sitems.org:16386/cms/dictionary
Integration of XML publishing pipelines within enterprise information systems.
Languages: Java, C/C++, PHP, Python, Ballerina; intensive use of XSLT, XPath, XQuery.
Datastores: BaseX, Berkeley DB, dbXML, relational databases, file based repositories.
APIs: REST/JSON/XML services for internal and external integration.
DevOps: Git, GitLab/GitHub, Linux deployment, Docker, CI/CD.

p.strong: Data integration and pipelines (Cosmobilis, Bilendi, Arturia, Made In Design, Kelkoo)

li.p: Design and implementation of end-to-end XML / text processing workflows for technical documentation, e-commerce catalogs, bibliographic datasets and clinical data across several companies.
Extraction of records from relational databases or legacy SGML/XML sources, transformation to XML via XSLT or custom scripts, and loading into XML databases, NoSQL stores or search engines.
ETL-style processing using Talend Open Studio and custom integration scripts for data import/export, quality checks and consolidation used by ERP, CRM and BI systems.
Architecture and maintenance of an in-house ESB-like orchestration layer connecting ERP, CMS, payment platforms and partners using XML/JSON APIs and scheduled file exchanges.

Proof-of-concept microservices and integration flows built with Ballerina (service orchestration, data transformation, API gateway patterns) including deployment of production-grade Ballerina jobs and services.

p.strong: Semantic and corpus-oriented work (Airbus, STMicroelectronics, Electre, HCForum)

li.p: Construction of structured corpora from heterogeneous sources (SGML, XML, relational DBs) for documentation systems, historical dictionaries and bibliographic platforms.
Fine-grained entity tagging (persons, places, dates, amounts, units) enabling downstream analysis, navigation, data extraction and reporting.
Design of controlled vocabularies and lookup structures to ensure consistency of labels, categories and identifiers across entire document collections.
Preparation of data for later mapping into RDF / SKOS and knowledge graph models, laying the foundation for semantic enrichment workflows.

p.strong: Search engines and access to data (Kelkoo, Bilendi, Electre)

li.p: Integration and configuration of Lucene-based search engines (including Solr-like stacks) and Vespa for high-volume catalog, product and document search.
Design of indexing schemas, analyzers and compound query models enabling faceted navigation, multi-field filtering and scalable full-text retrieval.
Exposure of search and retrieval capabilities through REST-style APIs consumed by B2B and B2C applications.
Design and maintenance of a schema-driven XML CMS proof of concept storing structured documents (data dictionaries, resumes, product sheets) in a native XML backend.
Advanced query engine enabling retrieval of content using schema-defined element types and structural rules.
Multi-version document management using "applicability" attributes to maintain multiple CV variants in a single XML file.
Integration of an XSD-driven WYSIWYG editor (Xopus) enforcing valid structures and automating authoring workflows.
Multi-channel publishing pipelines generating HTML, Markdown wiki output and PDF from the same XML source. Demo: http://www.sitems.org:16386/cms/dictionary.

p.strong: Document publishing and reporting (Airbus, STMicroelectronics, AIS Berger-Levrault)

li.p: Implementation of XML / XSLT publishing chains for large technical manuals and structured editorial content.
Transformation of marked-up sources into structured reports and documents used by business teams and regulatory bodies.
Experience with MIF (FrameMaker Interchange Format), PostScript and PDF generation pipelines ensuring consistency and high-quality layout.
Engineering degree, Polytech Grenoble (computer science and automation).
DEUG A, Université Joseph Fourier, Grenoble.
Scientific Baccalaureate, Grenoble.

section.p: Structured content systems, data processing pipelines, open/semantic data, search engines, and outdoor activities.
